title: "Good Architecture Cannot Fix a Bad Street": Smart Density's 'Building Charm' Aims for Better Neighbourhoods
summary:
Throughout October UrbanToronto is featuring a special State of Housing 2026 editorial series to examine the pressing housing challenges facing Toronto and the Greater Golden Horseshoe.

* * *

It is a feeling that we are all familiar with: walking through a new neighbourhood, with brand new streets and buildings designed with high quality streetscapes and architecture, but there is still a certain something... missing. A feeling of whimsy and charm that you get when walking through older neighbourhoods, a certain je ne sais quoi, that seems to be absent as you wander the streets of newer housing developments.
